#SILVER DEFICIT STREAK 2021 Deficit 2022 Deficit 2023 Deficit 2024 Deficit 2025 Deficit 2026 Deficit Six consecutive years. Name another major commodity with a similar streak.

#Silver For every 100 ounces of silver the world needs… It is expected to produce only about 94 ounces this year. The difference is coming from recycling and inventory drawdowns. That’s what a structural deficit looks like.
